ns2:course.label: Electronic Commerce
ns2:course.description: Graduate seminar in Electronic Commerce (EC), focusing on the integration of IT and business models. Topics include: (1) business-to-consumer EC; (2) business-to-business EC; (3) enterprise information management; (4) infrastructure development; (5) knowledge management; and (6) EC strategy. Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
